messages.text: I do not understand the segmentation - didn’t PR 115 introduce the tiled silicon readout modules ?
I’ll check PR #115 against the geometry used for the plot. I used the upstream ODD samples, so the view may not show the tiled nODD modules you’re referring to.

Yes. [PR #115](https://github.com/asalzburger/nodd/pull/115) restored the tiled silicon readout:

- **16 wedge carriers** per endcap.
- **112 sensor tiles per wedge/layer:** 76 square and 36 custom edge sensors.
- **90 mm square sensors**, subdivided into nominal **5.5 mm pads**.

I used the wrong geometry in the earlier plot: upstream ODD’s continuous silicon wedges.

I’ve corrected [PR #118](https://github.com/asalzburger/nodd/pull/118). The view below shows the tiles, raw muon hits, and custom pad boundaries. Source hashes and hit IDs passed independent checks. Marlin remains deferred.

![Corrected tiled nODD endcap view](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/asalzburger/nodd/026efea28b4a8c58fbc0e1426dfa5d61d7118dea/docs/validation/issue117/previews/nodd-tiled-endcap-xy.png)
